title: Splinter
tagline: Your beam splits on everything it touches. Aim into the crowd.
description: A survival run where the weapon fires itself and the only thing you control is where you stand. Your beam refracts: every enemy it passes through splits it into two dimmer beams heading off at an angle, and those split again. Fired into open space it does almost nothing; fired into a packed crowd it fans out into a cascade that clears the screen. Levelling up offers three upgrades, and nearly all of them change how the light comes apart rather than how hard it hits. You will die. What you earned buys permanent upgrades for the next one.
author: HexCave
howToPlay: Move; the beam fires itself. Every enemy it passes through splits it.
Firing into a crowd cascades. Firing into space does nothing.
Die, spend what you earned, and go again.
goal: Survive as long as you can, and bank prisms for the run after this one.

1.1.0.notes: In-game coaching: short hints that appear where they are relevant and retire once you have got it.
